tips.text: Check The Circuit before grinding Onslaught; Khora is one of its weekly picks and most players get her there.
Run Onslaught solo or in a premade squad; public squads often leave around zones 2 to 4 and host migration costs your progress.
Bring a nuke frame such as Harrow, Mirage, Saryn, Equinox, Volt or Gauss to reach zone 8 faster.
Push to zone 8 each run; Rotation C has the best part chance.
Start Khora's three-day build the moment the last component finishes.
Expect the nine Kavat Genetic Codes to annoy you more than the part drops do.
Players now call the part farm a mild grind, though bad streaks of several hours with one part missing still happen.
